🧹 Dojo Sweep

Find the SOL hiding in any Solana wallet — empty token accounts, NFTs you don’t want, forgotten Magic Eden bids — and get it back in one click, plus NFTs stuck in staking. 1% Dojo fee — same as ORE takes. Paid only when it works.
Empty accountsevery empty token account holds ~0.002 SOL of rent

Scanning is read-only. To sweep, connect the wallet you scanned (top right).
Everything is built in your browser and tested (simulated) before your wallet sees it — you approve every transaction in your own wallet, and nothing is sent without that. Closing an empty account only removes the empty shell: whatever token it held is already gone. Burning is permanent. Your Degen Dojo, Demon Dojo and TETO NFTs are never offered for burning. The 1% Dojo fee rides inside each transaction (to shamanchef.sol) and is shown before you sign.
